annotations.title: Set or clear a site password

description: Changes the access setting stored for a slug on deed.page. Inputs: slug, password, and token. password is 8 to 200 characters, or an empty string (or null) to clear the password. The call writes a scrypt hash into the site record on deed.page, or removes that hash, and contacts no outside system. Setting a password is available on Hobby and Pro; Free returns plan_required. Clearing is allowed on every plan.

password.description: New password, 8 to 200 characters. Pass an empty string (or null) to clear the password and make the site public.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: set_site_access
